differences.what: Cabinet body: A's tinted shell sits near-crushed in muddy brown (median luma ~24, 1% crushed) so the woofer, side panels and bottom drivers merge into one dark block; B lifts the body (median ~36, no crush) and the woofer surround, cone, internal panels and lower ports read clearly
Cabinet colour: B's shell goes cool blue-grey against an all-amber forest, which looks slightly milky and pasted in; A's warm smoked tint belongs to the light of the scene
Horn: B's clear horn and its reflection of the throat are a touch more neutral and crisper against the haze; A's is warmer and flatter. The edge and stand rods are the same in both
Overall grade: B is slightly desaturated with cooler fog and ground (more blue in the floor); A keeps a richer, more cohesive golden-hour mood in the trees and light shafts
Silhouette against the floor: B's lighter body separates the base and its foot shadow from the dark leaf litter; in A the bottom edge sinks into the ground
